fact: We Are Tech Africa reports the government platform Faso Arzêka, run through the Treasury directorate, takes payment of eTimbre tax stamps, motor-vehicle tax, residence tax and customs duties by app, web and USSD *700#.
source_slug: 2025-01-30 Burkina Faso launches Faso Arzeka digital payment platform

fact: The Ministry of Economy and Finance says the Prime Minister officially launched FASO ARZEKA, a single platform for payments to central government, local authorities and public establishments that consolidates the Treasury, tax and customs platforms.
Burkina24 reports public-administration payments such as the vehicle tax and levies can be paid directly through Orange's Max It app, per Orange's Abdramane Diallo.
The CNSS social-security fund launched the eCNSS Burkina app on 28 October 2025, which lets employers pay contributions by bank transfer order or mobile money.
